header.name: Research Methods
header.description: This course focuses on improving the skills of scientific reading, writing, presentation, and carrying out literature review for research. In particular, students practice scientific writing via short assignments. They are provided with exercises on research paper reading along with writing short critiques on research papers read. Students will practice on presentation skills and on conducting literature review.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students have improved ability to search for suitable literature and critically read research papers.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students have improved ability to structure and write good technical/research reports.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students have improved ability to make good technical presentation.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students have the ability to understand and follow copyright/plagiarism rules and practices prevalent in scientific literature.

lecture_topics: Principles of effective scientific writing: grammar, crafting better sentences, Organization of the paper
Research paper reading and writing short critique
Thorough discussion on digging the literature for writing literature review along with problem motivation- building the Introduction section of a research paper
Writing a short technical research paper
Student Presentations on Research paper submitted and Discussion
